I been farming this 3 mu for 30 years now, just me and my wife at home. The land here in Quzhou is flat, we got the well so water is not a big worry, but electricity for pumping costs money. Wheat-maize double crop, same as everyone around here does.

For wheat, I plant in October after the maize comes off. I use improved variety seed from the dealer in town — Jimai or Shiluan type, whatever they have fresh. Last year I used about 15 kg seed per mu, that worked fine. Before planting I spread diammonium phosphate, maybe 2 bags for the 3 mu, that's like 33 kg per mu of DAP, gives me phosphorus and some nitrogen to start. Then in spring when the wheat greens up around March I topdress urea, about 20 kg per mu. Total nitrogen come out around 18 kg per mu pure N I think. Potassium I don't buy separate much, the compound fertilizer has some. I water 2 times usually — once before winter to settle the roots, once at jointing in spring. If it's dry I add one more at grain filling. Spray for aphids and rust maybe 2 times. Plough the field before wheat, that's what we always do after maize. Expect around 450 kg per mu, good year maybe 500.

For maize, I plant right after wheat harvest in June, no-till or just light rotary, no time to plough. Zhengdan 958 or Xianyu type hybrid seed, everyone plants these. At planting I put compound fertilizer in the row, about 40 kg per mu of 15-15-15 type. Then at big trumpet stage I topdress urea heavy, 25 kg per mu, maize eats a lot of nitrogen. So total N maybe 22-24 kg per mu. Water 2 times if rain is short — summer here we get some rain but not always enough. Spray once or twice for borer and armyworm. Maize yield around 550 kg per mu normally.

I don't change much year to year. What works works. My neighbor Old Wang tried cutting fertilizer one year to save money and his yield dropped bad, so I don't risk that. Better to spend the extra 100 yuan on fertilizer than lose 200 yuan of grain.
